# MindMedix AI — Hospital Operations Intelligence
> https://mindmedixai.health
> contact@mindmedixai.health
> Ancona, Italy

MindMedix AI is a European healthcare AI startup building predictive operational intelligence for hospitals. We help healthcare systems anticipate workforce shortages, detect burnout risks, and optimize operations before crises occur.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Ancona, Italy
- Focus: Predictive hospital operations intelligence
- Validation: 97% recall on staffing shortage prediction, 97.1% LOWO accuracy
- Dataset: 34 real hospital wards (Ceschia et al. 2023)
- Compliance: GDPR-ready, EU AI Act-ready
- Prediction horizon: 3 weeks in advance
- Cost impact: €2,400 saved per prevented crisis

## Core Offerings

- Predictive workforce intelligence for hospitals
- Staff shortage forecasting and burnout risk detection
- Operational decision support for hospital administrators
- Privacy-first healthcare data infrastructure

## Target Audience

- Hospital directors and administrators
- Healthcare operations leaders
- Regional health authorities
- Strategic innovation partners

## Technology

- Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS (web)
- NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis (backend)
- Python, XGBoost (prediction engine)
- Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform (infrastructure)
